column2: It was only an exercise. He will never make that mistake for real.
You come home from your sixth deployment. Your spouse says she is done raising the kids alone. What will you do?
You took an instructor job in Coronado. Dinner every night. It saved your marriage.
Too little, too late. The divorce went through.
Sign the papers
You signed. The Teams are your family now. That is the problem.
Your squad is ambushed seconds after landing on a beach in {country}. The boats are drifting and the coxswain is hit. What will you do?
Lead the counterattack
You charged the treeline and broke the ambush. Navy Cross.
killed in a beach ambush
You were hit leading the charge up the sand.
Get everyone to the boats
You dragged the coxswain aboard and got everyone out. No losses.
A round caught your calf in the surf zone.
Running on Empty
Eighteen years in the Teams. You cannot remember the last time you felt excited about anything. What will you do?
Take a month of leave
You surfed, slept, and played with your kids. You feel human again.
Volunteer for another rotation
You kept going. Your family is starting to worry about you.
You are a BUD/S instructor. A student with frostbitten hands is crying in the surf but refuses to quit. What will you do?
Quietly encourage him
He made it through Hell Week. You saw a younger you in his eyes.
Push him harder
He made it. He hates you. He is ready.
He rang the bell. You wonder if you broke him.
Your team intercepts a semi-submersible drug sub in the Pacific. The crew scuttles it and it is sinking fast. What will you do?
Save the crew
You pulled four men from the water. The cargo went to the bottom.
Grab the evidence
You hauled out three bales before it sank. The Coast Guard got the crew.
The hull rolled on you. Cracked ribs and a near drowning.
Bad Knee, Big Op
Your knee is held together by scar tissue and ibuprofen. The surgeon says one more hard fast-rope could end it. What will you do?
You ran comms from the ship. The team did fine.
You made it through the op. Your knee is the size of a grapefruit.
Your ACL snapped on the rope. Surgery and a year of rehab.
Teaching His Son to Swim
{buddy} was killed last year. His widow asks if you can teach their son to swim this summer. What will you do?
He swims like his dad. It hurts and heals at the same time.
You could not face it. The check helped. She noticed.
On a VBSS, your team finds a hidden hold full of dehydrated migrants. The crew is armed and edgy. What will you do?
Secure the crew first
Crew flex-cuffed in seconds. Then water for everyone.
One crewman lunged with a machete. You stopped him, bleeding.
Get water to the migrants
Two of them would not have lasted another hour.
During a combat swim in {country}, you are placing a limpet on a hull when the ship's propeller starts turning. What will you do?
Finish the placement
Mine set, timer running, you finned clear. Bronze Star.
killed by a ship's propeller
The wash dragged you toward the screws.
Abort and swim clear
Mission scrubbed. You are alive and furious.
Credit Where It's Due
Your team tracked a target for months. An Army unit got the hit, and the credit. What will you do?
Grumble to the command
JSOC quietly corrected the internal record.
You came off as petty. "Same team," the admiral said.
The Doorway Dream
You keep dreaming about a doorway in {country}. Last night you yelled at your daughter over spilled cereal. What will you do?
It is slow, but you are sleeping again. You apologized to your daughter.
Whiskey helps for an hour. Then it really does not.
Command Master Chief
You are offered command master chief of a SEAL Team. It means trading your rifle for a desk and politics. What will you do?
You are now the senior enlisted voice of the Team. You miss the water.
Stay operational
You turned it down. The young guys are glad.
Demo Range Shortcut
The demo range closes in 20 minutes. Someone wants to skip the misfire wait time to finish. What will you do?
Wait the full time
You finished late. Everyone kept their fingers.
Nothing happened. You got lucky.
The charge cooked off as you approached. Wounded, then investigated.
You find a teammate selling government night vision on an auction site. What will you do?
NCIS took it from there. He is facing federal charges.
He pulled the listing and returned the gear. Close call.
He sold it anyway. You were questioned for knowing.
Snipers on the Fantail
An American captain is held by pirates in a lifeboat towed behind a destroyer. Rough seas, night. Your snipers have three targets. What will you do?
Take the simultaneous shot
Three shots, one sound. The captain climbed aboard alive. Silver Star.
A swell threw off a shot. Negotiations resumed and tension soared.
Wait for a better swell
Patience paid. The lifeboat steadied and the shots went clean.
Partner commandos you are advising in {country} are kicking a bound prisoner. Your interpreter looks at you. What will you do?
Step in and report it
You stopped it. The partner commander is furious. You sleep fine.
It was not your fight, you told yourself. It haunts you.
Fire Below Decks
A fire breaks out on the ship carrying your team. Sailors are trapped behind a smoke-filled hatch. What will you do?
Go below
You pulled three sailors out of the smoke. Bronze Star.
Burns and smoke inhalation. But they lived.
Help damage control
You ran hoses with the fire party. Fire contained.
Giving Away His Gear
{buddy} has been withdrawn since the last deployment and just gave away his favorite knife. What will you do?
Go see him tonight
You sat on his porch until 0300. He agreed to get help. He is alive.
You were too late. You will carry this forever.
Wait until Monday
He missed muster Monday. He is in the hospital. You should have gone.
Cheating on the Swim
As a BUD/S instructor, you catch a star student holding onto a buoy line during a timed ocean swim. What will you do?
He was dropped. Integrity is the real evolution.
He graduated. You will always wonder about him.
Shark on Insertion
During an over-the-beach insertion, something large bumps your swim pair in the black water. What will you do?
Keep swimming
It lost interest. Mission completed. Story secured.
It came back and bit your leg. Bad night.
Abort to the boat
Safe and annoyed. The team will never let you forget it.
Little Creek DUI
After a team party in Virginia Beach, {buddy} insists he is fine to drive. He is not. What will you do?
He cursed you all the way home. He thanked you the next day.
Let him drive
He made it home. Pure luck.
He was arrested for DUI. His career is in jeopardy.
Thirty feet down on a night combat swim, your rebreather starts making you dizzy. Possible CO2 buildup. What will you do?
Signal and surface
You bailed out properly. The rig had a cracked canister.
It cleared up. You finished the swim.
killed by a rebreather failure
You passed out. Your swim buddy dragged you up.
Taking the Platoon
You take over a SEAL platoon. Your chief has 18 years in the Teams and a stare that could kill. What will you do?
Listen more than talk
Your chief decided you are "one of the good ones." High praise.
Maritime Raid Plan
You have six hours to plan a raid on a dhow anchored off {country}. Intel conflicts on the number of guards. What will you do?
Plan for worst case
You brought a second boat. Turns out you needed it.
Intel was right. Fast, quiet, and clean.
Twice as many guards. Two of your men were hurt.
Admiral's Question
You brief the admiral on a plan. He asks a question you cannot answer. The room goes silent. What will you do?
He respected the honesty. You had the answer within the hour.
Bluff it
You guessed right. Your heart rate did not.
He knew. Your career just got a lot quieter.
Civilians in the Building
The HVT is in a house with women and children in {country}. An airstrike is available now. What will you do?
Raid instead
Target captured. Every civilian walked away.
The raid got hot. You were hit in the shoulder.
You must rank three outstanding junior officers. Only one can get the top block. What will you do?
Rank on merit
Fair and painful. One of them stopped saying hi.
Favor the one up next
SDV Battery Fault
Hours into an SDV transit in cold water, the mini-sub reports a battery fault. The target is 4 miles away. What will you do?
Abort to the host sub
You made it back to the dry deck shelter. Safe.
Push on with reserve
You reached the target and got out. Barely.
Stranded for six hours in freezing water. Hypothermia.
Lawyers rewrote the ROE. Your chief says it will get someone killed on the next boarding. What will you do?
The ROE was clarified. Your men trust you more.
Twelve-foot seas on mission night off {country}. The boats can make it, barely. What will you do?
Wait for calmer seas
Window lost. Everyone alive.
Launch the boats
The weather covered your approach. Total surprise.
Wives at War
Two operators' spouses are feuding, and now the operators are not speaking either. What will you do?
The US ambassador in {country} wants your platoon to stay inside the embassy. Your mission needs you on the coast. What will you do?
A detailed risk brief won her over.
Diplomacy wins today.
Cash on the Objective
One of your best operators pocketed cash from a raid site. He says it was for a fallen teammate's family. What will you do?
He lost his Trident. You did the right thing. It hurt.
He turned the money in. Nobody found out.
NCIS found it. You were charged too.
At a multinational exercise, a foreign naval commando unit keeps bragging about their pool times. What will you do?
Your platoon quietly won every scenario.
Challenge them to a swim
You crushed them. They bought the beer.
They won by a full minute. Humbling.
The CIA says the target is on boat A. Your own source says boat B. You get one shot. What will you do?
Trust your source
Boat B. Jackpot.
Boat A was right. He is gone.
Empty boat. Lots of fish.
Your dive physical shows an irregular EKG. A full workup could pull your dive quals. What will you do?
Benign. Cleared to dive.
You had a cardiac episode on a training swim.
Ops Officer Offer
You are offered a second tour as Team operations officer. Your family wants you home more. What will you do?
You make every soccer game. You miss the Teams daily.
Insurgents in {country} claim to hold one of your SEALs. Proof of life is uncertain. What will you do?
Launch a recovery now
It was a hoax. Your man was safe all along.
A news site reports your platoon's location aboard ship. Higher suspects your chain. What will you do?
Investigators looked closer at you because of it.
A helicopter goes down near your position at night in {country}. Fighters are converging on the crash site. What will you do?
You held the crash site all night against waves of fighters. Every crewman lived. Medal of Honor.
You were hit holding the perimeter.
Wait for the QRF
Your platoon needs new rebreathers. The justification package is 40 pages. What will you do?
Write it yourself
Three weekends gone. Approved.
Delegate to your LPO
Done in two days. Better than you would have written it.
Congressman's Photo Op
A congressman touring Little Creek wants a photo with "real SEALs." Your men refuse. What will you do?
He got a photo with a mannequin in a wetsuit. Close enough.
Order one to pose
Face blurred. Your men think less of you.
Mountain Recon Compromised
Your four-man recon team in the mountains of {country} is spotted by goat herders, then surrounded by dozens of fighters. What will you do?
Expose yourself to radio
You walked into the open to get a signal and saved your team. Medal of Honor.
killed calling for help during a mountain ambush
You were hit making the call.
Fight down the mountain
You tumbled down to a friendly village. Alive.
You fell down a cliff and were shot.
A fellow officer briefed your platoon's work to the commodore as his own. What will you do?
Your chief knows. That is what matters.
Correct the record
Set right, politely.
You looked petty.
Lost in Translation
Your interpreter mistranslates during a tense meeting with a coastal militia chief. Hands drift toward rifles. What will you do?
Calm it down
A smile and shared tea defused it.
Shots were fired. A short, ugly firefight.
DEVGRU Green Team
You are invited to screen for the Naval Special Warfare Development Group. It is brutal and secretive. What will you do?
You made it through Green Team. A new world.
You were not selected. Back to your Team.
Stay with your Team
Your platoon is glad you stayed.
Burning Cargo Ship
Your platoon boards a hijacked tanker. The hijackers set fire to the cargo hold. What will you do?
Secure the bridge
You captured the hijackers and turned the ship upwind.
Smoke inhalation. Hijackers escaped on a skiff.
Get everyone off
Crew evacuated. The ship burned for two days.
Joint Exercise Snub
A Marine general publicly calls SEALs "glory hounds" at a joint briefing. Your men are watching you. What will you do?
Stay professional
You let your platoon's performance answer him.
He laughed. Respect earned.
He called your commodore.
You take command of a SEAL Team. A risky raid in {country} needs your approval tonight. What will you do?
Success. The commodore is thrilled.
In a closed Senate session, a senator asks if you would approve the failed op again. What will you do?
Your candor earned trust on the committee.
SDV Budget Cut
The Pentagon wants to cut SEAL Delivery Vehicle funding by 20%. What will you do?
Fight it at the Pentagon
Training took the hit.
He appreciated it. The raid was approved.
A major newspaper wants a profile of the commodore of Naval Special Warfare Group. What will you do?
Quoted out of context. The admiral called.
Rear Admiral Shortlist
You are on the shortlist for rear admiral. It means leaving the Teams for a Pentagon office. What will you do?
You retired to Coronado. Surfing awaits.
An inspector general report criticizes the command climate at your Team. What will you do?
A British SBS commander proposes a joint maritime op off {country}. Political risks are high. What will you do?
The alliance strengthened. Target captured.
A family asks you to speak at their son's funeral. The Trident pins are already lined up on his casket. What will you do?
Ask his chief to speak
Contractor's Wink
A defense contractor hints at a $600K job after retirement if you favor their bid now. What will you do?
A hurricane floods Virginia Beach. Your neighbors are stranded on rooftops. What will you do?
Grab a boat and help
You pulled families off rooftops all night.
At a Teams reunion, an old buddy tells your story wrong. It is getting more heroic every year. What will you do?
Gold Star Speech
A Gold Star family asks you to speak at their son's old high school. What will you do?
The kids were spellbound. Three asked about BUD/S.
It had THC in it. Captain's mast.
Memorial Day Murph: run a mile, 100 pull-ups, 200 push-ups, 300 squats, run a mile, all in a 20 lb vest. What will you do?
Do it in the vest
Done in 48 minutes. For the fallen.
Rhabdo scare. Two days in the hospital.
Cheer the others on
A new guy groans that today was brutal. {buddy} grins and looks at you to deliver the line. What will you do?
Only easy day was yesterday.
The new guy rolled his eyes. He will say it to someone else in five years.
Buy him a beer instead
Sometimes kindness works better than slogans.
Family in the Dark
Your kid asks why you missed his birthday and where you were. You cannot tell him. What will you do?
Promise the next one
He hugged you. You hope you can keep that promise.
Take him surfing all weekend
He forgot all about it. You did not.
